input.command: EV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-review-code-XXXXXX) && git diff --cached > "$EV/staged.patch" && mkdir "$EV/candidate" && git checkout-index -a --prefix="$EV/candidate/" && mkdir "$EV/base" && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$EV/base" && echo "$EV" && git rev-parse HEAD && git ls-files -s && ls -R "$EV" && cd "$EV/candidate" && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1
input.description: Materialize staged candidate/base and run tests
